公於是比次篇類整齊分抄裁為推步七巻立成二巻厯議擬槀三巻轉神選擇二巻上中下三厯註式十二巻二十三年繼為太史令遂上表奏進

bounded_interpretation.positive: Two distinct early authorial accounts preserved in one later received anthology each REPORT a 立成二卷 work; one explicitly differentiates an earlier unsettled numerical manuscript stage from subsequent compilation and presentation.
non_equivalence: The one surviving G893 Kyujanggak 奎貴893 catalogued 1冊 102張 is NOT proved identical to original two-卷 submitted 立成; 一冊 cannot be equated to 一卷.
No exact original Yuan source leaves were collated. Different author passages are not two physically independent print witnesses.
G894 七政算內篇 and 1673 Ogawa Japanese six-卷 table are separate work/version branches, not automatic same-copy evidence.
The 元文類 received text has no native G893 solar 日差少／微 fifth/sixth digit, radix, quantization/carry instruction or numerical six-control adjudication.
Do not infer text-composition date equals edition/impression/copy/digital-surrogate date.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: 立成二卷 in a received earlier authorial inventory cannot prove copy identity or direct lineage to G893/other later similarly named works.
